description.zh:
- 可选字段

- 格式内容：{
  "product_id": "1",
  "platform": "ae"
}
- product_id  商品id
- platform 商品所属平台，支持ae/icbu/lazada
description.en:
- Optional field  

- Format: {  
  "product_id": "1",  
  "platform": "ae"  
}  
- product_id: Product ID  
- platform: Platform to which the product belongs. Supported platforms are ae, icbu, and lazada.
